request: Analyze GSE156174 for PMID 34836964 (Transcriptional responses of skeletal stem/progenitor cells to hindlimb unloading and recovery correlate with localized but not systemic multi-systems impacts.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (NextSeq 500, HISAT2/featureCounts mm9), mouse bone-marrow Lin-LEPR+ SSCs (FACS) and immuno-depleted cultured MSCs
final.primary_estimand: Effect of hindlimb unloading (HU, mechanical disuse) vs ambulatory (AMB) controls on SSC and MSC transcriptomes at 8wk and 14wk; plus SSC transcriptome after 8wk HU + 8wk reloading (HUR) vs age-matched AMB
final.sample_inclusion: One pooled RNA library per group: RNA pooled from 3-4 mice per group (S2.4.p1, S4.2.p1, S4.2.p2, S4.7.p1); 10 libraries total, no biological replicates
planned_contrasts: 8wk HU vs AMB in SSC (S2.4.p1; paper: 3991 DEGs)
8wk HU vs AMB in MSC (S2.4.p1; paper: 1504 DEGs)
14wk HU vs AMB in SSC and MSC (S2.5.p2; counts only in Supplementary Fig. 5d,e, 'fewer than 8wk')
HUR vs AMB SSC pseudo-time K-means clustering (S2.6.p2-p3; no DEG count)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none (pools of different mice per group)
final.paper_method: edgeR exact test with a FIXED dispersion of 0.2 (no replicates to estimate dispersion), TMM calcNormFactors, filter sum of counts > 2, protein-coding transcripts only (S4.8.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.9.p1 (general 'p <= 0.05'); DEG rule for RNA-seq not stated in S4.8.p1; Fig. 3c-e highlight Log2FC > 2

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The intervention is hindlimb unloading (disuse, the opposite of mechanical loading/exercise) and reloading recovery; there is no exercise arm. Every group is a single library of RNA pooled from 3-4 mice (S4.7.p1). The paper fitted edgeR exactTest with a dispersion fixed at 0.2 because no replicate exists (S4.8.p1). The DEG threshold for RNA-seq is not stated.

checks: GEO samples = 10 libraries matching S2.4-S2.6 groups (8wk/14wk AMB/HU x SSC/MSC + HUR + recovery AMB SSC)
data_processing: HISAT2 + featureCounts mm9, raw transcript counts = S4.8.p1

ownership.reasoning: Paper's code-availability statement names GSE156174; sample groups and processing match.

alignment.reasoning: Tar-merged columns become GSM ids; exact match on metadata index (inspect: 10/10).

matrix.reasoning: Integer fraction 1.0, max 1.8e6; GEO data_processing 'featurecount ... raw transcript counts'; features are Ensembl transcript IDs (ENSMUST), matching the paper's transcript-level edgeR input (S4.8.p1).

final.analysis_type: two-group per cell type and duration (as paper)

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast and no replication: (1) the intervention is hindlimb unloading/disuse and reloading, with no exercise or training arm; (2) every arm (cell type x treatment x duration) is ONE library of RNA pooled from 3-4 mice (S4.7.p1), so each comparison is n=1 vs n=1 with zero residual degrees of freedom. Between-sample variance cannot be estimated; the paper's 3991/1504 DEGs come from an edgeR exact test with an assumed dispersion of 0.2 (S4.8.p1), a fixed assumption rather than inference. No valid DE model exists for these data.

candidates.value: HUR vs recovery AMB (reloading as a 'loading' contrast)
candidates.reason_rejected: n=1 vs n=1 pooled SSC library; reloading is recovery from disuse, not exercise

candidates.value: pool durations (8wk+14wk) as replicates of HU vs AMB within cell type
candidates.reason_rejected: changes the estimand (duration and age differ; the paper treats them as separate cohorts; 14wk MSC libraries used total-RNA prep vs poly-A for all others, S4.7.p1) and still gives n=2 vs 2

candidates.value: edgeR exactTest with fixed dispersion 0.2 as the paper did
candidates.reason_rejected: the dispersion is assumed, not estimated, so DEG counts reflect the chosen constant; no runner executor supports a fixed dispersion and hand-written models are not allowed

design.reasoning: S4.7.p1, S2.4.p1 (pooled BM N=3 mice), S4.8.p1 (dispersion 0.2). GEO has exactly one sample per group.

discrepancies.data: one pooled library per group; edgeR dispersion fixed at 0.2
